name: Harpy
description: A Harpy is a vicious, winged predator with the body of a bird and the head of a cruel, cunning humanoid, known for swooping down to snatch up unsuspecting prey. Though not as physically imposing as larger beasts, their sharp talons and keen instincts make them formidable hunters in the skies.

actions.name: Talons
actions.description: The harpy makes an attack with their talons, dealing physical damage. This attack deals an additional 3 physical damage against creatures that are grappled by another harpy through the Grab action.

actions.name: Grab
actions.description: The harpy attempts to latch on to a medium or smaller creature, grappling it. While grappling a creature in this way, the harpy cannot use the Talons action. Additionally, the harpy cannot lift a medium creature without the aid of another harpy using the Abduct reaction.

actions.name: Adbuct
actions.description: In response to another harpy attempting to use the Move action while grappling a medium creature with their Grab action, the harpy adds a 1d4 bonus to the contested roll to move a grappled target. On a success, the harpy moves with the grappled creature as if it were also attached.

actions.name: Soft Landing
actions.description: In response to falling, the harpy spreads it's wings and attempts to reduce their impact by adding 2d4 to their acrobatics check when mitigating fall damage.

traits.name: Natural Flight
traits.description: The harpy must take the Move action once per turn to maintain their currently elevation while using their fly speed. If not, they immediately fall at the end of their turn.
